 Man With Butcher Knife Arrested on Brooklyn Set 
 Add TMZ on Google 
 By TMZ Staff 
 Published 
 October 24, 2026
 12:45 PM PDT 
 Play video content 
 CHAOS ON SET 
 Video: Man Armed With Butcher Knife Arrested on Michael B. Jordan’s ‘Miami Vice ’85’ Set 
 BACKGRID 
 Michael B. Jordan 's gritty crime drama just got a little too gritty ... as a man allegedly showed up to the set with a huge butcher's knife and started scaring the film crew.
 The NYPD tells TMZ ... Alex Perez , 23, allegedly started disrupting filming while running across the set of "Miami Vice '85" in Brooklyn around 11 PM Friday night.
 Backgrid 
 Cops were called after Perez allegedly brandished a butcher's knife ... and threatened one of the production staffers.
 In video exclusively obtained by TMZ ... Perez can be seen being escorted off the set by a staffer before taking out the large knife from his sweatshirt pocket.

 BUSTED 
 Launch Gallery
 Gallery 
 Backgrid 
 A cop on the scene then arrested Perez -- who hurled the n-word at the production staff member while in cuffs -- at 11:17 PM.
 Perez -- who has 5 prior arrests for alleged gang-related activities, assault with a firearm, and burglary, to name a few -- was charged with menacing with a weapon in the 2nd degree and criminal possession of a weapon in the 4th degree.
